name: @caotang/import-textbundle
description: The TextBundle and TextPack reader for the Markdown interchange of Ulysses, Bear and iA Writer (#282): a .textbundle folder or a zipped TextPack, read into the import block list over the Markdown reader, with the app's comments, tags and Content Blocks mapped. No DOM and no third-party dependencies, so it runs on the main thread, in a 'self' Worker and in Node.
